Ohad Ashur, son of Malki (Malka) and David, was born on the 9th of Heshvan 5761 (7 November 2000) in Kfar Yona. He was the younger brother of Uri and Ratem.

Ohad grew up and was educated in Kfar Yona. He attended the "Amal" elementary school and then the six-year "Ish Shalom" school in his town. He was a bright and talented student, with an engineer's mind, full of creativity and an artistic spirit.

In seventh grade he joined the school's robotics team, where he stood out as a key member, both as a student and as a professional mentor.

Ohad was active in the FIRST Israel program for more than a decade. Among other things, he served as captain of the Kfar Yona team "BumbleB" and represented it with distinction in international competitions.

Ohad played the clarinet and the guitar, and performed at events of his school and of the Kfar Yona Conservatory.

In preparation for significant military service, Ohad took part in the "Hamesh Etzba'ot" (Five Fingers) movement, through which he built himself personally and physically. This movement was a significant factor in shaping Ohad's character.

He wrote about his activity in the movement: "The main thing I took from the place is the desire to influence. Little by little I began to understand that my goal is to influence as many people as possible, and that influencing is not simple, but in my opinion it begins with the simplest and most basic things there are... Suddenly I realized that a smile, looking people in the eye even when it isn't easy, can make the situation a little simpler."

At the end of his studies he enlisted in the IDF and was assigned to the Engineering Company (Pelah"n) of the Paratroopers Brigade in the Infantry Corps.

In 2021, ahead of his release from regular service, he met Shani, then a soldier at the "Glilot" base. The two exchanged glances, and Ohad "joined her on her shift." From there the path was paved to a full and loving relationship. Ohad and Shani were inseparable from then on.

Ohad loved to go on adventures in nature. One of his hobbies on these adventures was "to reduce the bag as much as possible," and so he was called upon for help every time a bag was packed. "Ohad always used to ask, 'Why do you need that?'" his parents wrote, "and we were surprised to discover how few pairs of underwear one really needs to take on any trip."

Ohad went on many adventures in Israel and abroad, among the trails that dusted his shoes: the "Israel Trail," the "Golan Trail," "Sea to Sea," "Nahal Hever," "Paso de los Vientos" (Argentina), "Torres del Paine" (Chile), and many more, hard and good.

On some of his adventures he was accompanied by "Mazal," the nickname Ohad gave to an old commercial van (a Tourneo) that he restored in the metal workshop he built at his parents' home. Mazal provided him and his loved ones with transportation, and also a comfortable bed and a projector. Mazal lost her life and "ascended to paradise" in 2022.

After his release, Ohad began working in the drone unit of Elbit Systems in Netanya as a drone pilot. Later he accompanied military units in the field during drone flight training.

So that he could devote time to his adventures, he chose to work part-time. Out of his attraction to creating with his hands, he began to specialize in welding and made iron creations in a workshop he set up in his home, using tools he had acquired. Thus the phrase "Ohad, I have a project for you!" became familiar whenever someone in his family wanted to request a product of Ohad's handiwork for themselves.

In the family and among all his friends, everyone knew: Ohad was the person they turned to when everything went wrong and nothing worked. When everything was going up in flames, Ohad would come, listen, think, and help. With endless calm and a willingness to do anything. In the end, after he had sorted things out in the best possible way, he would also tell how much fun it had been.

As a sporty person, both as an adult and as a young man, he devoted his free time to sports he loved: diving, skiing, running, tennis, yoga, and climbing walls. To be precise, as his loved ones wrote: Ohad hated running and mentioned it often, but being a persistent person, he decided he wanted to succeed at running and therefore made sure to train for it.

On ski trips, Ohad was the first to get on the lift when the resort opened in the morning and the last to come down the mountain slopes, a second before (or even a little after) the ski resort closed.

More than enjoying the sport itself, Ohad enjoyed bringing his loved ones along with him, and so Shani also caught the "wall climbing" bug.

Ahead of the 2024/25 academic year, Ohad enrolled in electrical engineering studies at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev.

On Shabbat, the 22nd of Tishri, Simchat Torah 5784, 7 October 2023, at six-thirty in the morning, the Hamas terrorist organization launched a surprise attack on Israel from the Gaza Strip. That morning, the war began.

On 7 October 2023, Ohad was called up to reserve duty as a fighter in the 6646 Reconnaissance Battalion of the "Shu'alei Marom" Division in the Infantry Corps. He was determined to bear the burden and to fight.

On 22 December 2023, Ohad managed to call his loved ones, promised that everything would be fine, and that they would see each other soon.

Master Sergeant Ohad Ashur fell in battle on the 11th of Tevet 5784 (23 December 2023). He was twenty-three years old when he fell. He was laid to rest in the military plot of the cemetery in Kfar Yona. He is survived by his parents, a brother, and a sister.
